mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate, as measured by the current FEDFUNDS value, indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period signals an economic slowdown that prompts the Federal Reserve to initiate rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer and housing demand, which strengthens corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (both RSAFS and HOUST rising) is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO below its 6-month moving average), a further decline in INDPRO signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month median, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5%) indicates an active monetary policy response to a weak labor market, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction signal (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE > 5%) is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals continued policy hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
